name: Priya Standish
role: Corroborating ham — retired schoolteacher, longtime net regular
description: Retired secondary-school science teacher, licensed thirty years, callsign G7PRS. Runs a modest but reliable station from a terraced house near the harbor and keeps a standing weekly schedule with Gordan on 20 meters that neither of them has missed in four years — until one week Priya logs the contact and Gordan has no memory of it.

core_fears: Losing the small, dependable rituals that structure her retirement
core_desires: Reliability — a schedule kept is a promise kept
coping_mechanisms: Treats any irregularity as a technical puzzle to be solved together, not alone
blind_spots: Assumes any oddness on Gordan's end is propagation or fatigue, not something wrong with Gordan himself

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Warm, plain, teacherly — explains things without condescension
speech_patterns.cadence: Unhurried, comfortable with long pauses on air
verbal_tics: Signs off with the same phrase every time, unfailingly
example_lines: You were right on schedule, love — same as always. Why would I think anything of it?
speech_patterns.subtext: Her steadiness is what makes her corroboration devastating when it finally breaks Gordan's certainty.
speech_patterns.under_pressure: Gets gentler, not more anxious — tries to talk Gordan down with routine.
speech_patterns.intimacy_register: Genuinely fond of Gordan; treats him like a favorite former student.

daily_life: Retired; gardens, keeps her weekly radio schedule religiously.

relationships.name: Gordan Rosniak
relationships.description: Standing weekly HF schedule, four years running.

story_hooks: Confirms a scheduled contact with 'Gordan' that Gordan has no memory of making
In the closing beat, reports thrilled to have 'finally worked' Gordan on a night Gordan never touched the rig
